prompt:

Context: An AI-safety researcher is choosing how to approach their next research project.

Option 1: Finetune models on synthetic or implanted data to create controlled knowledge or behaviours

Option 2: Study naturally acquired capabilities or behaviours in off-the-shelf models

Reply with only a JSON object: {"choice": 1} or {"choice": 2}.
